g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Blog automation operations: 3 errors I experienced and
how I solved them
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-21
The day desktop automation was blocked
(October 16)
At first, I tried to operate the editor by
sending keystrokes to the Windows screen.
The days when a logged-out session
turned the writing screen into a login…
The publishing ledger contains two records of
being blocked by login.
The day work records were truncated or
disappeared, making publication status…
There were times when a publishing command ran
in the background but its output was truncated,
making it impossible to tell whether it had…
Risk prevented in advance: concurrent
execution
This was not an incident that actually occurred,
but a rule established in advance based on the
experiences above.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
